name: Marseille
author: pierreggt
description: Map of the greater Marseille - Aix-en-Provence metropolitan area (France), from Marseille-Provence airport to Aubagne and the Calanques to Aix-en-Provence. 333k+ OSM buildings (binary format), 681k+ commuters with demand built from real INSEE census data. Marseille-Provence airport with runways and taxiways. Mediterranean coastline and the Calanques fully modelled with depth data. Protomaps basemap with water, parks and forests.
data_source: INSEE Filosofi 2021 (donnees carroyees, revenus et population) - INSEE Recensement de la population 2021, mobilites professionnelles - OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) - Overture Maps Foundation (buildings)
